### Fabrication signals
- **Math extraction card** — "GSM8K extraction TP rate: 0.5 -> 1.0" — A perfect 1.0 (100%) true positive rate? Extremely suspect without qualifying the sample size.
- **Adversarial audit card** — "k=5 ensemble catches 60/60 attacks" — 100% success rate on an adversarial benchmark without a credibility anchor (what were the attacks?) looks fabricated or heavily overfitted.
- **Features (Code) card** — "99.3% of wrong code flagged" — 99.3% is an alarmingly high confidence metric for arbitrary LLM code generation.
